answer.sql:
WITH annual_premium AS (
    SELECT
        p.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
    FROM policy p
    JOIN policy_amount pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    GROUP BY p.Effective_Date
)
SELECT
    coverage_start_date,
    annual_premium,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (annual_premium - LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY coverage_start_date))
        / NULLIF(LAG(annual_premium) OVER (ORDER BY coverage_start_date), 0),
        2
    ) AS pct_change_from_previous
FROM annual_premium
ORDER BY coverage_start_date;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 5 THEN '0-5 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 10 THEN '6-10 miles'
    WHEN Nearest_Firestation_miles <= 15 THEN '11-15 miles'
    ELSE 'More than 15 miles'
  END AS distance_band,
  COUNT(*) AS number_of_claims,
  AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS average_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Nearest_Firestation_miles IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY distance_band
ORDER BY MIN(Nearest_Firestation_miles);

SELECT
    (Year_Built // 10) * 10 AS decade_built,
    CAST((Year_Built // 10) * 10 AS VARCHAR) || 's' AS decade_label,
    AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS num_claims
FROM fire_claim
WHERE Year_Built IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY decade_built, decade_label
ORDER BY decade_built;

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE Loss_Ratio >= 1.0) / COUNT(*) AS pct_loss_ratio_ge_1
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Fireplace)) IN ('yes', 'y', 'true', '1') THEN Loss_Ratio END)
  - AVG(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(Fireplace)) IN ('no', 'n', 'false', '0') THEN Loss_Ratio END) AS loss_ratio_difference
FROM fire_claim;

SELECT CORR(Number_of_Firefighters, Loss_Ratio) AS correlation_coefficient
FROM fire_claim;

answer.sql:
WITH period_premium AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Identifier,
        p.Effective_Date,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS annual_premium
    FROM policy p
    JOIN policy_amount pa
        ON pa.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
    JOIN premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE p.Policy_Number = 31003000336
    GROUP BY p.Policy_Identifier, p.Effective_Date
),
bounds AS (
    SELECT
        arg_min(annual_premium, Effective_Date) AS first_premium,
        arg_max(annual_premium, Effective_Date) AS last_premium,
        MIN(Effective_Date) AS first_start,
        MAX(Effective_Date) AS last_start
    FROM period_premium
)
SELECT
    first_start,
    last_start,
    first_premium,
    last_premium,
    date_diff('year', first_start, last_start) AS years,
    POWER(last_premium::DOUBLE / first_premium, 1.0 / date_diff('year', first_start, last_start)) - 1 AS cagr
FROM bounds;

SELECT Number_of_Firefighters, AVG(Loss_Ratio) AS avg_loss_ratio
FROM fire_claim
GROUP BY Number_of_Firefighters
ORDER BY avg_loss_ratio ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  MEDIAN(Loss_Ratio) FILTER (WHERE Year_Built >= 2000) AS median_loss_ratio_2000_or_later,
  MEDIAN(Loss_Ratio) FILTER (WHERE Year_Built < 2000) AS median_loss_ratio_before_2000
FROM fire_claim;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  c.Claim_Identifier,
  DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Open_Date) AS days_incident_to_open,
  DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) AS days_open_to_close,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 100.0 * DATE_DIFF('day', c.Claim_Open_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
         / DATE_DIFF('day', o.Occurrence_Begin_Date, c.Claim_Close_Date)
  END AS pct_time_open
FROM claim c
JOIN occurrences o
  ON c.Occurrence_Identifier = o.Occurrence_Identifier
ORDER BY c.Claim_Identifier;

WITH losses AS (
    SELECT SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN claim c
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    WHERE YEAR(c.Claim_Open_Date) = 2019
      AND (
            ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
         OR ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
      )
),
premiums AS (
    SELECT SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    WHERE pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Policy_Amount_Identifier FROM premium)
      AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier IN (
            SELECT Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
            FROM policy_coverage_detail
            WHERE YEAR(Effective_Date) = 2019
      )
)
SELECT
    l.incurred_loss,
    p.total_premium,
    l.incurred_loss::DOUBLE / NULLIF(p.total_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio_2019
FROM losses l
CROSS JOIN premiums p;

SELECT
  c.Company_Claim_Number AS claim_number,
  cat.Catastrophe_Name AS catastrophe_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_loss,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount END), 0) AS expense_pct_of_loss
FROM claim c
LEFT JOIN catastrophe cat ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_amount ca ON c.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY c.Claim_Identifier, c.Company_Claim_Number, cat.Catastrophe_Name
ORDER BY c.Company_Claim_Number;

answer.sql:
SELECT
  ca.Claim_Identifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_to_reserved_ratio
FROM claim_amount ca
LEFT JOIN loss_payment lp ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_payment ep ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN loss_reserve lr ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN expense_reserve er ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
ORDER BY ca.Claim_Identifier;

WITH coverage_claims AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Claim_Identifier
    FROM claim_coverage cc
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
),
coverage_losses AS (
    SELECT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM coverage_claims cc
    JOIN claim_amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN loss_amounts la
        ON la.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
coverage_premiums AS (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_amount
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    pcd.Effective_Date AS coverage_start_date,
    COALESCE(cp.premium_amount, 0) AS premium,
    COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0) AS incurred_loss,
    CAST(COALESCE(cl.incurred_loss, 0) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(cp.premium_amount, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
JOIN policy p
    ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN coverage_premiums cp
    ON cp.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
LEFT JOIN coverage_losses cl
    ON cl.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM claim_coverage cc
    WHERE cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
)
ORDER BY p.Policy_Number, pcd.Effective_Date;

WITH agent_policies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT apr.Party_Identifier AS agent_id, p.Policy_Identifier
    FROM agreement_party_role apr
    JOIN policy p ON p.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
    WHERE apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AG'
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT pa.Policy_Identifier, SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium pr ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY pa.Policy_Identifier
),
policy_loss AS (
    SELECT Policy_Identifier, SUM(Claim_Amount) AS total_loss_paid
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier, ca.Claim_Amount
        FROM policy_coverage_detail pcd
        JOIN claim_coverage cc ON cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
        JOIN claim c ON c.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
        JOIN claim_amount ca ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
        JOIN loss_payment lp ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    ) t
    GROUP BY Policy_Identifier
)
SELECT
    pe.First_Name,
    pe.Last_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ap.Policy_Identifier) AS policies_sold,
    COALESCE(SUM(pp.total_premium), 0) AS total_premium,
    COALESCE(SUM(pl.total_loss_paid), 0) AS total_loss_paid
FROM agent_policies ap
JOIN person pe ON pe.Person_Identifier = ap.agent_id
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp ON pp.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
LEFT JOIN policy_loss pl ON pl.Policy_Identifier = ap.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY ap.agent_id, pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name
ORDER BY policies_sold DESC, pe.Last_Name, pe.First_Name;

WITH claim_amount_ids AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM expense_reserve
),
claim_costs AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Total_Claim_Cost
    FROM claim_amount ca
    JOIN claim_amount_ids ids
        ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ids.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
),
claim_zip AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        la.Postal_Code,
        c.Claim_Open_Date,
        c.Claim_Close_Date
    FROM claim c
    JOIN insurable_object io
        ON c.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN geographic_location gl
        ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la
        ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cz.Postal_Code,
    COALESCE(SUM(cc.Total_Claim_Cost), 0) AS Total_Claim_Cost,
    AVG(date_diff('day', cz.Claim_Open_Date, cz.Claim_Close_Date)) AS Avg_Days_To_Close
FROM claim_zip cz
LEFT JOIN claim_costs cc
    ON cz.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cz.Postal_Code
ORDER BY cz.Postal_Code;

SELECT
  pe.First_Name,
  pe.Last_Name,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier) AS number_of_coverage_periods,
  SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier) AS avg_premium_per_coverage_period
FROM person pe
JOIN agreement_party_role apr
  ON apr.Party_Identifier = pe.Person_Identifier
 AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'PH'
JOIN policy po
  ON po.Policy_Identifier = apr.Agreement_Identifier
JOIN policy_coverage_detail pcd
  ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = po.Policy_Identifier
JOIN policy_amount pa
  ON pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN premium pr
  ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
GROUP BY pe.First_Name, pe.Last_Name
ORDER BY total_premium DESC;

SELECT
    p.Policy_Identifier,
    p.Policy_Number,
    a.Assessment_Identifier,
    a.End_Date AS Assessment_End_Date,
    p.Effective_Date AS Policy_Effective_Date,
    date_diff('day', a.End_Date, p.Effective_Date) AS Days_Between_Assessment_End_And_Policy_Effective,
    per.First_Name AS Underwriter_First_Name,
    per.Last_Name AS Underwriter_Last_Name,
    ar.Assessment_Result_Type_Code AS Assessment_Result
FROM policy p
JOIN agreement_assessment aa
    ON aa.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
JOIN assessment a
    ON a.Assessment_Identifier = aa.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN assessment_result ar
    ON ar.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
JOIN underwriting_assessment ua
    ON ua.Assessment_Result_Identifier = ar.Assessment_Result_Identifier
LEFT JOIN assesment_party_role apr
    ON apr.Assessment_Identifier = a.Assessment_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code IN (
        SELECT pr.Party_Role_Code
        FROM party_role pr
        WHERE pr.Party_Role_Name ILIKE '%underwriter%'
           OR pr.Party_Role_Code ILIKE 'UW%'
   )
LEFT JOIN person per
    ON per.Person_Identifier = apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY p.Policy_Identifier;

answer.sql:
WITH claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        ca.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment)
                 THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_paid,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier IN (SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve)
                 THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserved
    FROM claim_amount ca
    GROUP BY ca.Claim_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cat.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    cat.Catastrophe_Name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_paid), 0) AS total_loss_paid,
    COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_reserved), 0) AS total_loss_reserved,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_paid), 0)
        / NULLIF(COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_paid), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(cl.loss_reserved), 0), 0),
        2
    ) AS paid_pct_of_incurred
FROM catastrophe cat
JOIN claim c
    ON c.Catastrophe_Identifier = cat.Catastrophe_Identifier
LEFT JOIN claim_losses cl
    ON cl.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
GROUP BY cat.Catastrophe_Identifier, cat.Catastrophe_Name
ORDER BY cat.Catastrophe_Identifier;

WITH obj_addr AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        io.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        la.Location_Address_Identifier,
        la.Line_1_Address,
        la.Municipality_Name,
        la.State_Code,
        la.Postal_Code
    FROM insurable_object io
    JOIN geographic_location gl
      ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
    JOIN location_address la
      ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
),
claimed_props AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        oa.Location_Address_Identifier,
        oa.Line_1_Address,
        oa.Municipality_Name,
        oa.State_Code,
        oa.Postal_Code
    FROM claim c
    JOIN obj_addr oa
      ON oa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
loss_amounts AS (
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_payment
    UNION
    SELECT Claim_Amount_Identifier FROM loss_reserve
),
incurred AS (
    SELECT
        oa.Location_Address_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS incurred_loss
    FROM claim c
    JOIN obj_addr oa
      ON oa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    JOIN claim_amount ca
      ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN loss_amounts l
      ON l.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY oa.Location_Address_Identifier
),
coverage_obj AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        Insurable_Object_Identifier
    FROM policy_coverage_detail
),
prem AS (
    SELECT
        oa.Location_Address_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS total_premium
    FROM policy_amount pa
    JOIN premium p
      ON p.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN coverage_obj co
      ON co.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    JOIN obj_addr oa
      ON oa.Insurable_Object_Identifier = co.Insurable_Object_Identifier
    GROUP BY oa.Location_Address_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cp.Line_1_Address,
    cp.Municipality_Name,
    cp.State_Code,
    cp.Postal_Code,
    COALESCE(i.incurred_loss, 0) AS incurred_loss,
    COALESCE(pr.total_premium, 0) AS total_premium,
    COALESCE(i.incurred_loss, 0)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(pr.total_premium, 0) AS loss_ratio
FROM claimed_props cp
LEFT JOIN incurred i
  ON i.Location_Address_Identifier = cp.Location_Address_Identifier
LEFT JOIN prem pr
  ON pr.Location_Address_Identifier = cp.Location_Address_Identifier
ORDER BY loss_ratio DESC NULLS LAST;
